prompt.project_info: 9:16 Japanese-style Fujifilm bridal portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original Korean woman with wind-swept dark-brown hair, wearing an ivory silk-satin mermaid wedding dress with secure opaque lining, refined neckline, delicate pearl waist chain and cathedral-length translucent veil. She smiles warmly toward the camera with a playful spark.
prompt.composition_elements: Confident body-twist pose in an open wildflower meadow, upper body facing camera, weight shifted to one hip, one hand touching the wind-blown veil and the other resting naturally at her side; meadow bokeh, distant trees and overexposed sky behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong golden-hour backlight creates a luminous veil halo, warm rim light, soft environmental fill, natural lens flare and glowing hair; joyful intimate bridal atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16, 35mm lens at f/1.4, Fuji Pro 400H pushed to ISO 800, prominent film grain, rounded Fujinon bokeh, lifted blacks, teal-cyan greens, peach-gold highlights and violet-blue shadows.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: 9:16 Japanese-style Fujifilm bridal portrait of a clearly adult original Korean woman with wind-swept dark-brown hair in an opaque-lined ivory silk-satin mermaid wedding dress, pearl waist chain and cathedral veil, standing in a wildflower meadow during golden hour with a confident body twist, warm genuine smile and one hand touching the billowing veil, powerful backlight creating a golden halo, soft meadow bokeh, 35mm f/1.4, Fuji Pro 400H pushed grain and luminous natural lens flare.
